fullTreeProof.scope: complete exact historical tree; workflow verifies all original blobs

sourceInventoryPolicy.originalFiles: fixture-index records SHA-256 and byte length for requiredOriginalSources; workflow independently verifies all 4195 historical blobs against fullTreeProof
sourceInventoryPolicy.runtimeAdditions: fixture-index records SHA-256 and byte length for each committed harness/friend/workflow addition
sourceInventoryPolicy.candidateCoordinationFiles: CAPTURE-SCHEMA.json, REPORT.md, CHANGES.md, diff.patch and hash manifests are candidate evidence, not game/runtime sources
sourceInventoryPolicy.requiredOriginalSourceSetRationale: 21-file minimum serialization plus directly exercised recipe-operation set; the capture runs in the complete 4195-blob historical project because this set alone is not a compilable project
sourceInventoryPolicy.executionCommit: fixture-index.execution.commit is read from LUCKBOUND_V5_EXECUTION_COMMIT, falling back to GITHUB_SHA; capture fails if neither is a full 40-hex commit
sourceInventoryPolicy.editorIdentity: fixture-index records Application.unityVersion and ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt including the actual revision; expected Editor is 6000.6.6f1 (d20c9ac777da)
sourceInventoryPolicy.sourceProofVerification: workflow verifies original tree proof before running tests; harness records its proof identity and required-source hashes

captureInvocation.argumentValue: project-relative or absolute path resolved and validated under Logs/Scenarios/V5Source/; target must be new or empty
captureInvocation.noArgumentBehavior: all 24 cases still execute and assert; no fixture/index files are written
captureInvocation.existingOutputBehavior: fail before capture if target directory exists and is non-empty
captureInvocation.nunitDiscovery: 12 public parameterized EditMode methods, each with en-US and es-ES TestCase arguments, yielding 24 discoverable invocations; no Ignore or runtime skip

indexOutputRecord.path: relative slash-separated path from capture root
indexOutputRecord.sha256: lowercase SHA-256 over exact file bytes
indexOutputRecord.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM for JSON/preimages; checksum.txt is 64 ASCII lower-hex bytes without newline

outputLayout.envelopeMeaning: envelope.json is the exact fixed-header SaveJsonCodec.Encode output (or the explicitly encoded synthetic negative); it is distinct from positive api-envelope.json, which preserves SaveRepository's raw dated JSON byte-for-byte
outputLayout.preimageMeaning: write-preimage.utf8 is the independently projected fixed-header preimage used to cotejar the checksum emitted by historical SaveJsonCodec.Encode; read-preimage.utf8 is projected from JsonUtility.FromJson of the emitted envelope before any Decode or normalization
outputLayout.apiMeaning: api-envelope.json is raw SaveProfileAsync/SaveSettingsAsync output with real observed savedAtUtc; api-observation.json records that timestamp and asserts only declared header fields differ from the fixed-header candidate
outputLayout.activeStringsMeaning: exact route, inventory, checkpoint, and result JSON strings exported with their source field/type and producer provenance; values remain strings in the outer V5 envelope

fixtureIndexRequiredFields: cases[] (caseId, culture, role, expected/observed decode, outputs[] path/bytes/sha256)
capturedAtUtc (observed metadata; not a deterministic golden)
verificationRules: exactly the 12 case IDs and 2 cultures; exactly 24 invocations and output groups
reject missing/extra/duplicate case IDs, cultures, files or output records
resolve every output path beneath the capture root; reject traversal and symlink escape
recompute SHA-256 and byte lengths from captured bytes; reject UTF-8 BOM and malformed lower-hex checksum
recompute SHA-256 on captured write-preimage bytes and compare with positive stored checksum; verify N0 changed bytes and retained P3 checksum
compare complete fixed-header envelope, write-preimage, read-preimage, checksum and recipe bytes across en-US/es-ES for culture-invariant cases
do not compare observed API savedAtUtc or capture time as fixed constants
inspect parsed JSON only for schema/role assertions; never regenerate preimage or canonicalize captured bytes
verify raw API and fixed-header outputs separately; verify active strings preserve exact source values
verify P3 required purchase, counter, settlement, Fortune and inventory receipt arrays are non-empty, and availableRenown is 33
B0/B1 are boundary observations, M0/M1 are marker negatives, and N0 is a checksum negative; do not conflate their roles
verify Unity XML reports all 24 invocations Passed, zero skips/ignored cases, and no tolerated exception/log failure
no captures or fixture writes when the explicit capture argument is absent
